output.reason: The version-level session data is strong evidence, but the brief never explains why TV app 5.2 stalls only in Kestria when it shipped to all eleven markets and the others are fine, which points to an interaction with Tessaline that it doesn't account for; even so, the next steps are clear and sensible.
